import csv
import pathlib
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile

archive_path = sys.argv[1]
rows = []
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as zf:
    names = sorted(
        n for n in zf.namelist()
        if not n.endswith("/") and n.endswith(".faa.mafft")
    )
    if len(names) != 255:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected 255 aligned .faa.mafft members, found {len(names)}")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        tmpdir = pathlib.Path(tmp)
        for idx, member in enumerate(names):
            aln = tmpdir / f"alignment_{idx:04d}.faa"
            aln.write_bytes(zf.read(member))
            result = subprocess.run(
                ["phykit", "parsimony_informative_sites", str(aln)],
                check=True,
                text=True,
                capture_output=True,
            )
            lines = [line.strip() for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
            if not lines:
                raise RuntimeError(f"No PhyKIT output for {member}")
            fields = lines[-1].split()
            if len(fields) != 3:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected PhyKIT output for {member}: {lines[-1]}")
            informative = int(fields[0])
            total = int(fields[1])
            percentage = float(fields[2])
            rows.append((member, informative, total, percentage))

with open("per_gene.tsv", "w", newline="") as handle:
    writer = csv.writer(handle, delimiter="\t", lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(["alignment", "parsimony_informative_sites", "total_sites", "percentage"])
    for member, informative, total, percentage in rows:
        writer.writerow([member, informative, total, format(percentage, ".15g")])

median_percentage = statistics.median(row[3] for row in rows)
with open("summary.tsv", "w", newline="") as handle:
    writer = csv.writer(handle, delimiter="\t", lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(["metric", "value"])
    writer.writerow(["selected_alignments", len(rows)])
    writer.writerow(["processed_alignments", len(rows)])
    writer.writerow(["failed_alignments", 0])
    writer.writerow(["median_percentage_parsimony_informative_sites", format(median_percentage, ".15g")])
